sentence: This project studies how to use machine learning together with known physical laws to predict the behavior of magnetized plasmas.
This project builds security methods that use several sensor types together to protect Internet-of-Things systems.
This project studies how defects in metallic alloys organize during permanent deformation, using synchrotron X-ray light and machine learning.
This project investigates cellular signaling through experimental, computational, and applied biosciences.
This project builds low-power spiking neural networks and searches for designs that let many devices learn together.
This project builds curriculum units on water quality and land use patterns and studies how well they teach earth and physical science.
This project develops tools that bring Fourier analysis to quantum systems, where signals are operators that are non-commutative.
This project studies how to make nanocrystalline diamonds at atmospheric pressure using flame vapor deposition coupled with plasma.
This project studies how solvent-induced interactions control the adhesion and aggregation of nanoparticles on surfaces with nanoscale topography.
This project builds protein hydrogel beads that capture and separate rare earth elements from aqueous streams.
This project studies how soft sticky adhesives break, resist fatigue, and switch between sticking and not sticking.
This project builds a software package that uses machine learning on plant flowering and fruit production to show how plant populations respond to environmental variation.
This project builds methods to compare, summarize, and visualize how tumors grow and develop over time using sequencing data.
This project builds a blood bag from a non-chlorinated polymer that does not leach harmful substances and tests how well it stores blood.
This project studies whether a science center can act as an intermediary between universities and industry.
